turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
Go ahead, Hale. I have a call at 4:40.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
That's not Owen's problem, Hale. You had time to enter a zero before anyone called me. So who decided, and on what basis?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then answer the question and it's over. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
